Cookie banner fixture

Four consent banners in the shapes cookie-consent blockers know: a WordPress "Cookie Notice" bar, a generic #cookieConsent box, a #cookieConsentBar, and a OneTrust SDK container. A blocker hides them by stylesheet or dismisses them by script; the page reports each banner's computed display and box on window.__banners().

Accepted: none
